sections.content: Add a possessive ending to say 'my': just -m if the noun ends in a vowel, or -om/-em/-öm (chosen by vowel harmony) if it ends in a consonant. ablak → ablakom (my window), ajtó → ajtóm (my door), lámpa → lámpám (my lamp — the final -a lengthens to -á), tükör → tükröm (my mirror — the last vowel drops).
tükröm looks irregular but it's a common pattern: some words lose their last vowel before a possessive ending (tükör → tükr-öm). You'll meet the same shift again with other -ör/-or words.
